content.title: Here’s what’s going to be open and closed for Easter 2026
content.text: NewsSeveral grocery stores, including Walmart and Giant, will be open on Easter 2026. Walmart/BJ's/ShopRite/Aldi/Canva/Katherine RodriguezBy Kaylyn Greene | kgreene@pennlive.comEaster is right around the corner, prompting many retailers to adjust their hours for the holiday.Easter is a Christian holiday that commemorates the resurrection of Jesus after his death at Calvary. This year, the holiday falls on Sunday, April 5. Following is a list of what you can expect to be open or closed on Sunday. Note that some of these stores or offices are typically closed on Sundays, regardless of the holiday.Places that will be closed include:CostcoSam’s ClubKarns LidlTargetAldiSharp Shopper Liquor storesMost public schools will be closed through the Monday after Easter, March 6, for spring breakLibrariesPennDOT Government officesRabbitransit BanksPost officePlaces that will be open include:Walmart, regular hoursGiant, open until 4 p.m.Weis, open from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.Trader Joe’s, regular hoursBJ’s Wholesale Club, open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Wegmans, regular hours. The pharmacy will be closed.
